### `generic_mag_app_test.rb`

**경로:** `components/generic_mag/gsw/GENERIC_MAG/procedures/tests/generic_mag_app_test.rb`


```ruby
require 'cosmos'
require 'cosmos/script'
require "generic_mag_lib.rb"

##
## This script tests the standard cFS component application functionality.
## Currently this includes: 
##   Housekeeping, request telemetry to be published on the software bus
##   NOOP, no operation but confirm correct counters increment
##   Reset counters, increment as done in NOOP and confirm ability to clear repeatably
##   Invalid ground command, confirm bad lengths and codes are rejected
##


##
##   Housekeeping, request telemetry to be published on the software bus
##
GENERIC_MAG_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    get_generic_mag_hk()
end


##
## NOOP, no operation but confirm correct counters increment
##
GENERIC_MAG_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    generic_mag_cmd("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_NOOP_CC")
end


##
## Reset counters, increment as done in NOOP and confirm ability to clear repeatably
##
GENERIC_MAG_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    generic_mag_cmd("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_NOOP_CC")
    cmd("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_RST_COUNTERS_CC") # Note standard `cmd` as we can't reset counters and then confirm increment
    get_generic_mag_hk()
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == 0")
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == 0")
end


##
##   Invalid ground command, confirm bad lengths and codes are rejected
##
GENERIC_MAG_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    # Bad length
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_NOOP_CC with CCSDS_LENGTH #{n+2}") # Note +2 due to CCSDS already being +1
    get_generic_mag_hk()
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")
end

for n in 6..(5 + GENERIC_MAG_TEST_LOOP_COUNT)
    # Bad command codes
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_NOOP_CC with CCSDS_FC #{n+1}")
    get_generic_mag_hk()
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")
end
```

### `generic_mag_ast_test.rb`

**경로:** `components/generic_mag/gsw/GENERIC_MAG/procedures/tests/generic_mag_ast_test.rb`


```ruby
require 'cosmos'
require 'cosmos/script'
require "generic_mag_lib.rb"

##
## This script tests the cFS component in an automated scenario.
## Currently this includes: 
##   Hardware failure
##   Hardware status reporting fault
##


##
## Hardware failure
##
GENERIC_MAG_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    # Prepare
    generic_mag_prepare_ast()

    # Disable sim and confirm device error counts increase
    dev_cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM DEVICE_COUNT")
    dev_cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM DEVICE_ERR_COUNT")
    generic_mag_sim_disable()
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM DEVICE_COUNT == #{dev_cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM DEVICE_ERR_COUNT >= #{dev_cmd_err_cnt}")

    # Enable sim and confirm return to nominal operation
    generic_mag_sim_enable()
    confirm_generic_mag_data_loop()
end
```

### `generic_mag_device_test.rb`

**경로:** `components/generic_mag/gsw/GENERIC_MAG/procedures/tests/generic_mag_device_test.rb`


```ruby
require 'cosmos'
require 'cosmos/script'
require "generic_mag_lib.rb"

##
## This script tests the cFS component device functionality.
## Currently this includes: 
##   Enable / disable, control hardware communications
##   Configuration, reconfigure generic_mag instrument register
##


##
## Enable / disable, control hardware communications
##
GENERIC_MAG_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    safe_generic_mag() # Get to known state

    # Manually command to disable when already disabled
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_DISABLE_CC")
    get_generic_mag_hk()
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")

    # Enable
    enable_generic_mag()

    # Confirm device counters increment without errors
    confirm_generic_mag_data_loop()

    # Manually command to enable when already enabled
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_ENABLE_CC")
    get_generic_mag_hk()
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_MAG GENERIC_MAG_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")

    # Reconfirm data remains as expected
    confirm_generic_mag_data_loop()

    # Disable
    disable_generic_mag()
end
```
